pattern_id: OOM from unbounded missing_blocks map growth when processing blocks with many missing ancestors
description: BlockManager missing_blocks map can grow unbounded leading to OOM when processing blocks with many missing ancestors
trigger_condition: Byzantine validator sends blocks referencing many non-existent ancestor blocks. Each missing ancestor is added to missing_blocks map without bounds checking.
root_cause: No limit on the size of missing_blocks map. Attacker can exhaust memory by referencing arbitrary non-existent blocks.
fix_approach: Add bounds checking on missing_blocks size. Reject blocks that would cause excessive missing block tracking.
